session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Bull Trend From Open, Trading Range Day'. Surprise bull breakout trend from the open into the 6238 top (bull triangles and the wedge under the bar 36 high), then the trading range with too many bars below the EMA as the bears broke out of the bull flag (shaded box to the measured move), the parabolic wedge bear trend into the 6185 low, and a late bull breakout that tested the 6225 breakout point into the close.
